image.text: <font face ="Verdana" size = "24">Flight Data – LRS Search and Rescue</font>

<font face ="Arial" size = "16">1 Notify CLE RCC (USCG). Note: Provide CLE RCC with the aircraft call sign, last known position, intended shoreline crossing point(s), and any other information which will assist them in the physical search.</font>

2 Format and transmit an ALNOT message using the GMSG tab in FLTSCAPE, in accordance with FAAO 7110.10 Flight Services, Section 8-4 and LMFS-OP-027 Conducting Domestic Search and Rescue. Note: FLTSCAPE does not post the aircraft to the SAR tab or assign SAR responsibilities; therefore, all SAR messages for Hazardous Area Reporting Services must be sent manually using Service B.

3 Initiate a communications search for aircraft. Check the destination airport, which should be the first landing point as indicated in the REMARKS field of the LRS flight plan. Additional calls should be made to airports in the vicinity of the destination shoreline.
4 Continue to conduct search and/or cancel the ALNOT in accordance with LMFS-OP-027 Conducting Domestic Search and Rescue.
